A dog is a domestic animal and is known as a very loyal and friendly pet. Dogs live with humans and help them in many ways. They are often called “man’s best friend.”

About dogs:

Dogs are intelligent and can be trained easily

They protect homes and people

They help police, soldiers, and rescue teams

Dogs can guide blind people

They are playful and loving companions

Food & care:

Dogs eat meat, rice, vegetables, and special dog food

They need clean water, regular exercise, and love

Dogs should be kept clean and taken to a vet for health checkups

Dogs teach us love, loyalty, and friendship ❤️
